target.title: fix(watch): defer restart when dist/entry.js is missing mid-rebuild
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a `git push` triggers source file changes while `dist/` is mid-rebuild, the hot-reload watcher (`watch-node.mjs`) unconditionally kills the current healthy gateway child process and restarts into a missing `dist/entry.js`, causing a crash-loop that exhausts systemd's restart limit (37-minute outage).

Fixes [#99603](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99603).

## Why This Change Was Made

`requestRestart()` in `scripts/watch-node.mjs` sent SIGTERM to the child process without checking whether `dist/entry.js` existed. During a rebuild (e.g. `rm -rf dist && pnpm build`), the entrypoint is temporarily missing. The fix adds `isBuildReadyForRestart()` which verifies `dist/entry.js` exists before killing the child.

If the entrypoint is missing, the watcher polls every 200ms until it reappears, then proceeds with the restart. A 5-minute timeout prevents infinite polling when the build never completes — in that case the current healthy process keeps running and the next file change will retry.

## User Impact

- **Before**: Source file changes during mid-rebuild → watcher kills healthy gateway → new child cannot start → crash-loop → systemd gives up → outage
- **After**: Source file changes during mid-rebuild → watcher waits for `dist/entry.js` → build completes → safe restart. Timeout after 5 min keeps the current process alive.

## Evidence

### Unit Tests (18/18 passed)
- `defers restart when dist/entry.js is missing` — build readiness guard
- `kills child normally when dist/entry.js exists` — normal path unaffected
- `gives up after timeout when build never completes` — timeout safety net

### Real Machine Gateway:Watch Proof (this machine, Linux x64, Node 22.19)

```
=== MAIN 分支（无修复） ===
[openclaw] Building TypeScript (dist is stale: missing_dist_entry - dist entry missing).
→ watcher killed healthy child, run-node had to rebuild mid-flight

=== 修复分支 ===
[openclaw] Build output not ready (dist/entry.js missing); waiting before restart.
→ watcher waited for dist/entry.js to appear
[openclaw] Build output ready; proceeding with restart.
→ safe restart after rebuild completed
```

## Changes

2 files, +207/-1:

- `scripts/watch-node.mjs` (+48): `isBuildReadyForRestart()` helper, `deps.fs` injection, build readiness guard in `requestRestart()` with polling + 5-min timeout
- `src/infra/watch-node.test.ts` (+159/-1): 3 new tests covering guard, normal path, and timeout behavior. `startWatchRun` defaults `OPENCLAW_WATCH_MODE=test` to preserve existing test isolation.
